description: Verified QA pairs for Northwind Robotics knowledge base. Each item lists the source document and an 'evidence' span that appears verbatim (after whitespace normalization) in that document. A retrieval is counted as a hit when a retrieved chunk overlaps the character range of this evidence span in the source document.

questions.question: How many PTO days do full-time employees accrue per month?
questions.evidence: accrue paid time off at a rate of 1.5 days per month

questions.question: How many total PTO days does an employee get per year?
questions.evidence: for a total of 18 days per year

questions.question: How long is the probationary period before PTO can be used?
questions.evidence: it cannot be used during the first 90 days

questions.question: What is the maximum amount of PTO that can be carried over to the next year?
questions.evidence: the maximum balance you may carry over is capped at 10 days

questions.question: How many paid sick days do employees receive each year?
questions.evidence: employees receive 10 paid sick days per year

questions.question: When is a doctor's note required for sick leave?
questions.answer: For any sick absence longer than 3 consecutive days.
questions.evidence: A doctor's note is required for any sick absence longer than 3 consecutive days

questions.question: How much paid parental leave does Northwind offer?
questions.answer: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
questions.evidence: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

questions.question: How much service is required to be eligible for parental leave?
questions.evidence: employees who have completed at least 6 months of service

questions.question: How many days of bereavement leave are available for an immediate family member?
questions.evidence: up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave for an immediate family member

questions.question: Which days are the company-wide anchor days?
questions.evidence: Tuesday and Thursday designated as company-wide anchor days

questions.question: How many days per week are most employees expected in the office?
questions.evidence: in the office at least 3 days per week

questions.question: What are the required core working hours?
questions.evidence: core hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in their local time zone

questions.question: How large is the one-time home office setup stipend?
questions.evidence: one-time home office setup stipend of $1,000

questions.question: What monthly internet reimbursement do fully remote employees get?
questions.evidence: $60 per month internet and utilities reimbursement for fully remote employees

questions.question: Above what value must stipend-purchased equipment be returned on termination?
questions.evidence: must be returned upon termination if its value exceeds $250

questions.question: Within how many days must expenses be submitted?
questions.answer: Within 30 days of the transaction date.
questions.evidence: submitted in Expensify within 30 days of the transaction date

questions.question: What expense amount requires an itemized receipt?
questions.evidence: Any single expense over $75 requires an itemized receipt

questions.question: What is the expense approval limit for a direct manager?
questions.evidence: Expenses up to $500 can be approved by your direct manager

questions.question: When can business class flights be booked?
questions.answer: For international flights longer than 6 hours, with director approval.
questions.evidence: Business class may be booked for international flights longer than 6 hours

questions.question: What is the meal per diem in the United States?
questions.evidence: meal per diem of $70 per day in the United States

questions.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate?
questions.evidence: reimbursed at $0.67 per mile

questions.question: What is the hotel spending cap in high-cost cities?
questions.evidence: $350 per night in high-cost cities

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.evidence: a password of at least 14 characters

questions.question: Which password manager must be used?
questions.evidence: stored in the company password manager, 1Password

questions.question: Is SMS-based MFA allowed?
questions.answer: No, SMS-based MFA is not permitted.
questions.evidence: SMS-based MFA is not permitted

questions.evidence: Devices must automatically lock after 5 minutes of inactivity

questions.question: How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported?
questions.evidence: must be reported to the security team within 1 hour

questions.question: What percent of the employee medical premium does Northwind cover?
questions.evidence: covers 100% of the medical, dental, and vision premium for employees

questions.answer: 100% up to 4% of salary, plus 50% of the next 2%.
questions.evidence: matches 100% of employee 401(k) contributions up to 4% of salary, plus 50% of the next 2%
